SELECT
  t.bucket AS shipping_delay_bucket,
  AVG(t.days_delay)::numeric AS avg_shipping_delay,
  AVG(t.review_score)::numeric AS avg_review_score,
  COUNT(*) AS orders_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    ABS((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)) AS days_delay,
    CASE
      WHEN ABS((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)) = 0 THEN '0 days'
      WHEN ABS((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)) = 1 THEN '1 day'
      WHEN ABS((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)) BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3 days'
      WHEN ABS((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)) BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '4-7 days'
      WHEN ABS((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)) BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN '8-14 days'
      WHEN ABS((o.order_delivered_customer_date::date - o.order_estimated_delivery_date::date)) BETWEEN 15 AND 30 THEN '15-30 days'
      ELSE '31+ days'
    END AS bucket,
    r.review_score
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
) t
GROUP BY t.bucket
ORDER BY MIN(t.days_delay);
